segments.name: Eggs and Butter
segments.description: Supplies pasture-raised eggs and butter sourced from small farms to natural and mainstream retailers, distributors and foodservice customers.
segments.evidence: The Company has only one reportable segment for which discrete financial information is available: Eggs and Butter.

revenueModel.text: Natural retailers, mainstream retailers, distributors and foodservice customers pay for pasture-raised eggs and butter.
revenueModel.evidence: The Eggs and Butter segment derives revenues primarily from sales of its products, including eggs and butter, to customers, which include natural retailers, mainstream retailers, distributors, and foodservice customers.
